D.6418
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date February 26, 1935.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY. No. D/6418 Date 26/2/35）

Subject: Recognition of Manchukuo by the Grand Duke Cyril and the activities of Colonel C. Tominaga.

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Ross

（左侧批注：See also files D.1006 & D.6457）

With reference to the attached cutting from the Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury of February 21, 1935, on the subject of the recognition of Manchukuo by the Grand Duke Cyril, it is interesting to note that Colonel C. Tominaga, Military Intelligence Officer, attached to the Japanese Ministry of War, passed through Shanghai on board the s.s. "Haruna Maru," February 19, en route to Yokohama after an extensive tour of Europe.

He was apparently travelling incognito, for his rank was not given in the passenger list and he appears thereon simply as "C. Tominaga," Japanese.

It is reported that Tominaga's real object in making the journey to Europe was to get into touch with Russian emigre circles, chiefly those in France, and to ascertain whether White Russian assistance could be counted upon against Soviet Russia in the event of the present strained relationship existing between the two nations developing into actual armed conflict and any possible invasion by Japan of the Maritime Province.

In this connection it is said that the recent announcement made by the Grand Duke Cyril, pretender to the Russian Czarist throne, that he intends shortly to send another Grand Duke to become Russian Czarist Ambassador to the "Empire of Manchukuo" is directly connected with, and is the fruit of, Tominaga's activities in Europe.

D. I. Ross
D. I.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

日期：1935年2月26日。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特科登记处。编号 D/6418 日期 35年2月26日）

事由：基里尔大公承认“满洲国”及富永中佐（C. Tominaga）的活动。

由 D. I. 罗斯撰写并呈报

（左侧批注：另见档案 D.1006 及 D.6457）

关于附上的1935年2月21日《上海晚邮报与信使报》剪报，内容涉及基里尔大公承认“满洲国”一事，值得注意的是，日本陆军省所属军事情报官富永中佐（Colonel C. Tominaga）于2月19日乘坐“榛名丸”号轮船途经上海，此前他在欧洲进行了广泛巡视，现正前往横滨。

他显然是微服出行，因为乘客名单上未列明其军衔，仅将其列为日本人“C. Tominaga”。

据称，富永此次欧洲之行的真正目的是与俄国流亡圈子建立联系，主要是法国境内的圈子，并查明若日苏两国目前紧张的关系发展为实际的武装冲突，以及日本可能入侵滨海边疆区时，能否指望白俄方面提供对抗苏联俄罗斯的援助。

在此背景下，据说自称俄国沙皇王位觊觎者的基里尔大公最近宣布，他打算不久派遣另一位大公出任驻“满洲国帝国”的俄国沙皇大使，这一声明与富永在欧洲的活动直接相关，且是其活动成果。

D. I. 罗斯
D. I.
副总监（特科）

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, April 27, 1935

'White Russians
Like "Manchukuo"

Grand Duke Cyril Sees
Better Conditions
Under New State

(United Press)
SAINT BERICA, Brittany, France, Apr. 26. — Grand Duke Cyril acknowledged claimant to the Czarist throne of Russia, declared that the most serious danger to the Bolshevik regime lay within rather than from abroad, and that the Communist state would be undermined by the people themselves instead of enemies abroad.

He asserted in an exclusive interview with the United Press that the White Russians (Czarists) never intended to declare war on the Soviet Union, expecting “salvation of holy Russia from within.”

“We shall never fight members of our own race,” he said emphatically, “for blood is thicker than water. We who live in exile look for salvation of Holy Russia from within, and not from without—and we shall NOT be disappointed.”

Keeps Fit By Walks
Cyril, tall, muscular, fit, made these declarations while pacing his room a simple study in his grey-stone villa overlooking the sea from this Brittany retreat. The Grand Duke keeps fit by long walks daily and workouts on the golf links. He believes fitness an essential part of his equipment for the day when he mounts the throne of the Romanoffs—which he confidently expects will arrive.

The interview centered around his appointment of General Kislitzyn, a faithful White Russian guardsman, who has lived for years in Anhucia, as his personal ambassador in “Manchukuo.” He is to represent the interests of 180,000 white Russians living in that Japan controlled state, and make friends with the Japanese.

“I appointed General Kislitzyn, who is friendly with the Japanese and “Manchukuo” authorities, so that they can consult him on all question concerning White Russian in “Manchukuo,” Cyril said

“At the same time the White Russians will have an official representative to apply to when necessary.

“He will be the ‘father’ of my people there, and I know he will carry out the task capably.

Position Improved
“The position of the White Russians, although still difficult economically, has improved in “Manchukuo,” due to the fact Japan has re-established there.

“As for eventual outbreak of hostilities between the Soviets and Japan, which I do not for a moment contemplate, I can assure you the White Russians will not march against Russian troops, for we do not believe in fighting our own people. We have no quarrel with the simple Russian people, whether they be soldiers, peasants or workingmen.”

《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1935年4月27日，星期六

‘白俄人士
青睐“满洲国”

基里尔大公认为
新政权下状况更佳

（合众社）
法国布列塔尼，圣贝里卡，4月26日电。——自称为俄国沙皇王位觊觎者的基里尔大公宣称，布尔什维克政权面临的最严重危险来自内部而非外部，共产主义国家将被其人民自身而非外部敌人所瓦解。

他在接受合众社独家采访时断言，白俄人士（沙皇派）从未打算对苏联宣战，而是期待“从内部拯救神圣俄罗斯”。

“我们绝不会与本族人作战，”他 emphatically 说道，“因为血浓于水。我们这些流亡者寻求从内部而非外部拯救神圣俄罗斯——而且我们不会失望。”

通过散步保持健康
基里尔身材高大、肌肉发达、体格健壮，他在俯瞰大海的灰色石别墅内的简朴书房中踱步时发表了上述声明。这位大公通过每日长距离散步和在高尔夫球场锻炼来保持健康。他认为，身体健康是他有朝一日登上罗曼诺夫王朝王座——他确信这一天终将到来——的必要准备部分。

采访围绕着他任命基斯利岑将军（General Kislitzyn）为其驻“满洲国”个人大使一事展开。基斯利岑是一名忠诚的白俄卫兵，已在安惠夏（Anhucia，音译）生活多年。他将代表居住在该日本控制国家的18万白俄人士的利益，并与日本人结交友好关系。

“我任命了与日本及‘满洲国’当局友好的基斯利岑将军，以便他们就有关‘满洲国’白俄人士的所有问题向他咨询，”基里尔说。

“同时，白俄人士在必要时也将有一位官方代表可供求助。

“他将是我在那里的人民的‘父亲’，我知道他能胜任此项任务。

地位改善
“尽管白俄人士在经济上仍然困难，但他们在‘满洲国’的地位已有所改善，这是因为日本在那里重建了秩序。

“至于苏联与日本之间最终爆发敌对行动——我片刻也不曾设想这种情况——我可以向你们保证，白俄人士不会进军反对俄国军队，因为我们不相信与本族人民作战。我们与普通的俄国人民没有仇怨，无论他们是士兵、农民还是工人。”

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Thursday, February 21, 1935

Grand Duke Cyril Gives
“Manchukuo” Recognition

(United Press)
PARIS, Feb. 21.—“Manchukuo” today took another stride,
such as it has, toward its goal of becoming an individual
nation of the world.
Grand Duke Cyril, pretender to the Russian Czarist throne,
joined Japan and El Salvador in official recognition of
“Manchukuo.”
The Grand Duke announced that he would immediately
send another Grand Duke to become Russian Czarist Ambassador to the “Manchukuo Empire.”
The purpose of this recognition, the Grand Duke Cyril explained, was to promote good relations between White Russians and “Manchukuo” and Japanese authorities.

《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1935年2月21日，星期四

基里尔大公给予
“满洲国”承认

（合众社）
巴黎，2月21日电。——“满洲国”今天向其成为世界独立民族国家的目标又迈进了一步，尽管这一步微不足道。
自称为俄国沙皇王位觊觎者的基里尔大公，加入日本和萨尔瓦多的行列，正式承认“满洲国”。
基里尔大公宣布，他将立即派遣另一位大公出任驻“满洲国帝国”的俄国沙皇大使。
基里尔大公解释说，此举承认的目的是促进白俄人士与“满洲国”及日本当局之间的良好关系。
